title: Reset your SSO password
text: Go to the identity portal, choose Forgot password and follow the link sent to your work email. Passwords expire every 90 days and must be 14 characters.

title: VPN client will not connect
text: If the VPN client hangs on Connecting, check the system clock, then reinstall the GlobalConnect profile. Error E4012 means the certificate on the laptop expired.

title: Request a new laptop
text: Hardware refresh is every three years. Open a hardware request in the service catalog and your manager approves it. Standard build ships in five business days.

title: Set up multi-factor authentication
text: Enroll the authenticator app from the identity portal. Push approvals are required for email, payroll and the VPN. Lost phone: call the service desk to reset MFA.

title: Expense report submission
text: Submit expenses within 30 days with itemized receipts. Meals over 75 dollars per person need a business justification. Reimbursement arrives in the next payroll run.

title: Book a meeting room
text: Rooms are booked from the calendar by adding a room resource. Large rooms over 12 seats need facilities approval. Release unused bookings so others can use them.

title: Printer shows offline
text: Power cycle the printer, then remove and re-add it from the print server. Error code P220 is a paper jam in tray 2. Toner orders go through facilities.

title: Shared drive access request
text: Folder owners approve access to shared drives. Request access from the file share page; contractors need a sponsor. Access is reviewed every quarter.

title: Onboarding checklist for new hires
text: Before day one the manager orders a laptop, requests accounts and assigns a buddy. In the first week complete security training and benefits enrollment.

title: Report a phishing email
text: Do not click links or open attachments. Use the Report Phish button in the mail client. If you entered credentials, reset your password and tell the security team immediately.

title: Parental leave policy
text: Employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of service. Notify HR at least 30 days before the expected start date when possible.

title: Wi-Fi drops in the office
text: Connect to the CORP-SECURE network, not CORP-GUEST. Forget the network and rejoin if it keeps disconnecting. Report dead zones with the floor and desk number.

title: Install approved software
text: Use the Self Service app to install approved software without admin rights. Software not in the catalog needs a security review, which takes about ten days.

title: Change your direct deposit
text: Update bank details in the payroll portal under Pay settings. Changes made before the 20th apply to the current month; later changes apply next month.

title: Travel booking rules
text: Book flights through the travel tool at least 14 days ahead. Economy class for flights under six hours. Hotels must be within the city rate cap.

title: Laptop running slow
text: Restart at least weekly so updates install. Check storage: under 10 percent free disk space slows everything. Browser tabs and sync clients are the usual culprits.

title: Monitor or docking station not detected
text: Unplug the dock power for ten seconds, reconnect USB-C, and update the dock firmware from Self Service. Dual monitors need the DisplayPort cable, not HDMI.

title: Data retention and deletion
text: Customer data is retained for seven years for audit. Deletion requests under privacy law are handled by the privacy office within 30 days.

title: Incident severity levels
text: SEV1 is a full outage of a customer-facing service and pages the on-call engineer immediately. SEV2 is degraded service. SEV3 is a minor bug with a workaround.

title: Badge not working at the door
text: Badges deactivate after 30 days without use. Visit the security desk in the lobby with photo ID to reactivate or replace a lost badge.

title: Mobile phone stipend
text: Eligible roles receive a monthly phone stipend of 50 dollars through payroll. Enroll the phone in device management before work email will sync.

title: Encrypt a USB drive
text: Removable drives must be encrypted. Right-click the drive and choose Encrypt with the corporate key. Unencrypted USB storage is blocked by endpoint policy.

title: Annual performance review
text: Reviews open in November. Write a self-assessment, request peer feedback from three colleagues, and meet your manager to agree goals for next year.

title: Outlook calendar not syncing
text: Remove and re-add the work account on the phone. If invites still do not appear, clear the local mail cache. Shared calendars can take an hour to sync.

title: Video call quality is poor
text: Use a wired connection when possible, close other video apps, and turn off HD video. Audio echo usually means two devices joined the same call.

title: Account locked out
text: After five failed sign-in attempts the account locks for 15 minutes. Old saved passwords on a phone are the usual cause. The service desk can unlock it sooner.

title: Work from abroad
text: Remote work from another country for more than 14 days needs HR and tax approval. Some countries are blocked for VPN access because of export rules.

title: Purchase order approval
text: Purchases over 5,000 dollars require a purchase order approved by finance. New vendors must pass vendor onboarding before the first PO is issued.

title: Backup and restore files
text: Laptops back up to cloud storage every night. To restore a deleted file, open the backup app, pick a date and select the file. Versions are kept for 90 days.

title: Holiday calendar
text: The company observes eleven public holidays plus two floating days. Floating holidays must be booked in the HR system before they are taken.
